product: Analyze agent usage and find wasted tokens with Unity Gateway Insights (Beta)
tagline: You can now generate Unity Gateway Insights reports that show what people use agents for and where tokens go to waste.
what_it_does: You can now generate Unity Gateway Insights reports that show what people use agents for and where tokens go to waste. Genie Code builds each report from a sample of sessions in the unified trace table. Beta Insights is in Beta.
why_it_matters: To track dollar spend, see Analyze Unity Gateway cost.
plain_summary: You can now generate Unity Gateway Insights reports that show what people use agents for and where tokens go to waste. Genie Code builds each report from a sample of sessions in the unified trace table.
key_takeaway: You can now generate Unity Gateway Insights reports that show what people use agents for and where tokens go to waste.
